content: The RTE Generator shall reject configurations where • multiple RteEventToTaskMapping s or RteEventToIsrMapping s reference the same RTEEvent within the context of one RteSwComponentInstance OR • multiple RteBswEventToTaskMapping s or RteBswEventToIsrMapping s reference the same BswEvent within the context of one RteBswModuleIn- stance
The RTE Generator shall reject configurations where the same RTEEvent instance which can start a RunnableEntity is referenced by multiple task mappings.
